$comment: Stress-test corpus. Every clip is CC0, public domain, or CC BY/BY-SA from
Wikimedia Commons, chosen to stress a DIFFERENT failure mode rather than to
flatter the pipeline. Licence and source are recorded per clip because the
same rule applies here as everywhere else in this project: nothing is used
Videos are downloaded into a gitignored directory and never committed.

NOTE: 'Jumping_jack_slow_motion.webm' was originally in this corpus and is an INSECT (a jumping jack ant), not a person doing jumping jacks. MediaPipe correctly detected nobody. Selecting clips by filename is not safe; look at them.

clips.stresses: unusual environment and harness-supported gait - a body moving in a way ordinary footage never shows
floor contact and full occlusion - a burpee puts the body prone, far from the upright assumption
in-place gait - travel is zero, so any root solve that fabricates motion shows up immediately
fast motion and two people - tests the smoothing bandwidth and single-subject assumption
near-static pose - almost no motion, so jitter has nowhere to hide
extreme non-upright pose - a deep side bend breaks the 'head above hips' assumption
upper body only - the legs are out of frame entirely, so contacts and root motion are undefined and MUST fail gracefully
seated people at a distance - small, partially occluded subjects and no gait at all
